max_passive_voice_ratio.description: Maximum allowed ratio of passive-voice sentences per draft.

min_authorship_attribution_score.description: Minimum composite Burrows Cosine Delta + cadence attribution score (0-100) required to pass forensic authorship verification.

allOf.description: Independent RIAs must enforce SEC Marketing Rule 206(4)-1 or FINRA 2210 supervision.
SEC/FINRA regulated profiles must require non-empty mandatory disclaimers on at least one channel.
If bullet lists are banned, allowed_bullet_glyphs must be empty.
24-hour ephemeral audio policy caps raw_audio_retention_days at 1.
Any third-party LLM inference path requires the deterministic pre-inference PII scrubber ON.
Non-isolated third-party LLM inference modes require explicit THIRD_PARTY_LLM consent in consent_scope.
Regulated & high-assurance regimes require human_review_gate.enabled = true and forbid NON_REGULATED in applicable_jurisdictions.
If AI disclosure is required, label_text (>=5 chars) and at least one channel are mandatory.
Public-sector high-assurance profiles require prompt_injection_firewall_mode = QUARANTINE_AND_HALT.
